summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for label analytics/dashboard simplification, admin label financial summary, upload flows, and auth playbook checks on preview URL. Core analytics, dashboard balances, top lists, admin six-metric summary, live update behavior, and multipart/direct-R2 flows passed. Two auth/security regressions remain.

critical.issue: CORS preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' instead of explicit origin while auth uses credentials/cookies.
Sub-admin password drift is not repaired. Existing sub-admin accounts are only created-if-missing; changed password hash is not updated to expected seeded credential.

action_items: Fix credentialed CORS behavior so preflight returns explicit allowed origin (not '*') for preview/auth routes.
Update seed_indexes_and_admins to also rotate/fix password hashes for existing sub-admin accounts, not only super admin.
Re-run iter34 auth playbook tests after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/seed.py currently updates password hash only for super_admin; sub-admin loop inserts only when account is missing. This breaks password drift recovery expectation.

Backend CORS code in server.py is explicit-origin oriented, but observed runtime preflight still emits wildcard '*'; likely ingress/edge CORS override should be reconciled with backend credentialed-cookie policy.

Label analytics aggregation and dashboard balance source-of-truth behavior matched requirements: status filter pending/available/withdrawn, legacy_settled excluded for label analytics, admin lifetime includes legacy where expected.
Legacy multipart upload now persists source to R2 (r2:// key present), enforces 10MB limit (413), and direct-R2 initiate/PUT/finalize flow remains healthy.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary ITER34_UI label/user/royalty lines/withdraws/releases for UI integration test via /app/tests/iter34_seed_label_dashboard_ui.py; cleaned after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_auth_playbook_public.py -v after CORS+seed fixes. UI analytics/admin checks passed on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 with no page-level horizontal overflow. No APIs were MOCKED.
rca of the issue: 1) CORS regression reproduction: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://lanjut-core.preview.emergentagent.com returns 204 and access-control-allow-origin='*'. For credentialed auth cookies this is invalid and can break browser auth flows. 2) Seed password drift reproduction: manually mutate support1@rilismusik.com password_hash, call POST /api/admin/migrate/ensure-indexes as superadmin, then support login with expected seeded password still fails (401). Root cause in routes/seed.py sub-admin logic only inserts missing users and never updates existing hashes.
